content.short: Gryphon is a decentralized liquid staking and money market platform built natively on the Injective blockchain.
content.description: Gryphon is a decentralized liquid staking derivative (LSD) platform and money market built natively on the Injective blockchain. It allows users to stake assets like INJ to receive liquid tokens like nINJ while continuing to earn network rewards. This approach unlocks capital efficiency, enabling users to participate in DeFi activities without losing their staking positions. Gryphon also features an integrated lending and borrowing protocol. The platform's goal is to enhance liquidity within the Injective ecosystem, providing a robust suite of financial tools through secure mechanisms.
